title: Get DIRECTV’s MySports Genre Pack and Save Nearly 25% Just for Signing Up
summary: Here's everything you need to know about DIRECTV’s MySports Genre Pack and why it’s a favorite for sports lovers.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

If you’re a sports fan, you might be frustrated with all of the different ways to watch games. For example: Pro football is spread across various networks, like NBC, ABC, CBS, FOX, ESPN and NFL Network, as well as a few streaming services, such as ESPN Unlimited Plan and others. But DIRECTV is the one streaming platform that is a step above the rest, especially when it comes to delivering live sports, like pro football games, to your 4K TV, smartphone, tablet, laptop or other internet-connected devices†.

DIRECTV MySports Genre Pack

Currently, you can get DIRECTV’s MySports Pack , which includes a blend of live and local networks, and streamers, for just $49.99 for the first month of service — $15 off, or a 23% savings. After the month is over, you can cancel the service altogether, or the regular monthly price auto-renews at $64.99 per month*.

The package features more than 20 live sports networks. It comes with networks, like ESPN, ESPN2, ESPNU, ESPNEWS, FOX Sports, FS2, MLB Network, NFL Network, NHL Network, NBA TV, CBS Sports Network, TNT Sports, TBS, Tennis Channel and others. It even includes local networks, such as ABC, CBS, NBC and FOX (where available).

Additionally, a subscription includes access to the premium ESPN Unlimited Plan to get more ESPN networks, like ESPN Deportes, SEC Network, ACC Network, ESPN on ABC, ESPN+, SEC Network+ and ACC Network Extra. The streaming service add-on has access to live sports for popular pro sports leagues, like NBA, MLB, NHL, WNBA, La Liga, Bundesliga, NWSL, UEFA, NCAA Football, College Football Playoff and much more.

The DIRECTV MySports Genre Pack also comes with “Multiview Mode” that allows you to watch up to four games on one channel^. This is ideal for the NFL since most games take place at the same time throughout Sundays during the regular season. The feature is best for fantasy football too, so you can pay attention to more than just one game at once.

For more information on MySports and this promotion, go to directv.com/affiliates/genre-packs .

*Auto-renews after free trial & 1-month promo at then-prevailing rate (curr. $64.99/mo.) unless you cancel. New users only. Local channels vary by market. Blackout restrictions apply. Select sales channels only. Prices may vary through third parties. Add’l terms apply.

^Multi-view available on compatible TVs; not available via devices. Includes channels in your DIRECTV plan.

This will not replace any existing Disney+, Hulu, ESPN, or Disney bundle subscription you may already have. All other accounts must be managed separately. You must remain on an eligible plan to retain your offer.

† Included apps vary by plan and may require Gemini device. Games not included with DIRECTV require separate paid app subscriptions.
